first_costs.accounting: Observed common preparation is charged once to each standalone arm; per-arm work is counted once; original native build is charged only to native NDU. Missing costs are null.

comparison.interpretation: Repeated negative observation under the same workload/calls/seeds and protocol, at a different exact repo commit. It adds a reproducibility check, not unseen heldout-task evidence, independent workload sampling or a statistical superiority result. The first result is retained separately; outcomes are not pooled to select a better attempt.

repeat_costs.accounting: Observed common preparation is charged once to each standalone arm; per-arm work is counted once; original native build is charged only to native NDU. Missing costs are null.

comparison.source_change_description: The bound hia_translation_validation.py changed its implementation digest from its own file only to the local semantic-source closure. The repo/source identity therefore differs. All other bound portfolio dependencies and the portfolio protocol have identical hashes; this is not a new workload or a new learned policy.

limitations: Same known workload and seeds were reused after prior outcomes; this is a repeat, not a new heldout study
All candidate deployment choices stayed at base; no actual profitable-candidate competition was observed
Native recursive evaluator uses exact-search supplied paths, not a trained cost predictor
Only declared measured preparation/build/decision/execution scope is known; human/acquisition/persistent-storage/final-aggregate costs remain unknown
Saved receipts and hashes are audit evidence, not hardware/toolchain soundness or native-memory-safety proofs
scope: Read-only independent arithmetic and structural inspection of original stored evidence. No benchmark, native executable or provider was invoked. No frozen code/protocol or prior report was changed.
